solutions.title: Prefix and suffix maxima
solutions.strategy: Precompute the tallest bar at or before each index and at or after each index, then sum local water depths.

timeComplexity.explanation: Prefix, suffix, and summation passes are linear.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Two arrays store left and right maxima.

solutions.title: Two pointers with running walls
solutions.strategy: Move inward from the smaller side, updating that side maximum and adding water when the current bar is below it.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each pointer advances at most n times total.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only pointers, running maxima, and the total are stored.
